package main

func compose() {
	mux := newMux()

	// THE ROUTE PARTITION (fixture)
	if cfg.IsControl() {
		mux.Handle("GET /api/v1/usage/view", usageHandler)
		// A control-plane registration that reaches the data plane. This is the defect.
		mux.Handle("/v1/repositories/", browser.New(reader, sessions, dataConn).Routes())
	} else {
		mux.Handle("/v1/repositories/", browser.New(reader, sessions).Routes())
	}
}
